questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which type of antonym is the pair hot/cold?
questions.explanation: Gradable antonyms are opposites on a scale such as hot/cold, tall/short, rich/poor.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which type of antonym is the pair alive/dead?
questions.explanation: Complementary antonyms are mutually exclusive opposites in the relevant classification, e.g. alive/dead, true/false.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which type of antonym is the pair buy/sell?
questions.explanation: Relational (converse) antonyms are opposite roles in a relationship: buy/sell, lend/borrow, parent/child.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which pair is an example of a relational (converse) antonym?
questions.explanation: Lend/borrow are opposite roles in a relationship, hence relational (converse) antonyms.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which pair is an example of a complementary antonym?
questions.explanation: Complementary antonyms are mutually exclusive opposites such as true/false.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which pair is an example of a gradable antonym?
questions.explanation: Gradable antonyms lie on a scale such as rich/poor.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which pair is an example of a relational antonym?
questions.explanation: Parent/child are opposite roles in a relationship, hence relational antonyms.
questions.source: Vocabulary.pdf — Three useful types of antonyms
